newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hartwall rises on strong 4-mth results.
newsitem.headline: Hartwall rises on strong 4-mth results.

text.p: Shares in Finnish beverages maker Oy Hartwall Ab rose sharply on Thursday after it reported better than expected 4-month results, brokers said.
At 1125/0825 GMT, Hartwall traded at 260.0 markka, up 19 markka or 7.9 percent. It briefly hit a year-high 266 markka.
Hartwall's January-April pre-tax profit rose to 69.5 million markka from 21.1 million in the year-ago period. The median of analysts' forecasts in Reuters poll had been 46.5 million markka.
"It (the share) can still go up today, but not much," one broker said. @
